description:
Energy simulation for Energy Community v2 DEMO/TEST tenants (AB#4571 value
simulator, AB#4579 demo-community generator, AB#4703 presentable community
extension; used e.g. by the energydemo tenant, AB#4569). Ported / extended
from the voest-app energy simulator.

NOT for productive tenants — install only where synthetic metering data is
wanted. The blueprint is a separate, optional sibling of EnergyCommunity.Base
precisely so productive installs never carry it.

Installs four DataFlows / seven pipelines. The value simulators come in two
generations: simulate-community (2.8.0, SimulateEnergyMeasurements@2,
preset-driven communities, e.g. the FH VSCT lab communities and eg-urstein)
and simulate-energy-measurements (@1, frozen for energydemo, decision D6).

REQUIRES a Mesh Adapter with SimulateEnergyMeasurements@2 (AB#5631) for the
simulate-community DataFlow. An adapter version is not expressible as a
blueprint dependency; an older adapter fails those two pipelines with an
unknown node type. The @1 pipelines and create-demo-community run on any
adapter that runs 2.7.0.

create-demo-community (ec0000000000000000000b04, DataFlow …b05, AB#4579 +
AB#4703, presets AB#5632)
  CREATES a self-contained demo energy community from one of six PRESETS,
  so demo/test tenants need no hand-seeded data and no EDA. Input of the
  ExecutePipelineCommand, every key optional (defaults shown):
    { "preset": "legacy", "seed": 1, "communityCode": "0000",
      "effectiveFrom": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "participationFrom": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z", "newRevision": false,
      "defaultZipcode": 5020 }
  A missing key gets its default; an unknown preset or a communityCode that
  is not 1-4 digits fails the run before anything is written.
  CITY PARENT (2.8.1, AB#6014): every facility gets a System/ParentChild to
  the Basic/City of its address zip code; a zip code the tenant has no city
  for (the fictional member addresses use 4021-4024, 5021, 5022) falls back
  to the city of defaultZipcode. REQUIRES Locations.Austria (or another
  Basic/City directory): without a city for defaultZipcode the run fails
  before anything is written, naming the zip code and Locations.Austria.

  | preset          | enum | consumers                    | producers                 | MPs | D corridor | U corridor |
  |-----------------|------|------------------------------|---------------------------|-----|------------|------------|
  | legacy          | 0    | 14 x H0 182500 kWh/a         | 3 x PV 132.8 kWp          | 17  | 14-19 %    | <= 1 %     |
  | pv-dorf         | 1    | 30 x H0 3500, 2 x G0 20000   | 12 x PV 15 kWp            | 44  | 40-55 %    | 55-68 %    |
  | gewerbepark     | 2    | 8 x G0 60000, 4 x H0 3500    | 4 x PV 100 kWp            | 16  | 55-75 %    | 12-35 %    |
  | landwirtschaft  | 3    | 10 x L0 12000, 15 x H0 4000  | 6 x PV 30 kWp             | 31  | 30-42 %    | 58-70 %    |
  | stadtblock      | 4    | 60 x H0 2500                 | 1 x PV 20 kWp             | 61  | 10-18 %    | <= 2 %     |
  | wasserkraft-tal | 5    | 25 x H0 3500, 2 x G0 25000   | 1 x hydro 30 kW, 2 x PV 10| 30  | 65-82 % *  | 25-40 % *  |
  D = coverage (allocated / consumption), U = undistributed share of the
  production, per calendar year; corridors from presets.py (check over
  seeds 1-30 green). * wasserkraft-tal is created now; the hydro producer
  (ProductionType HEP) gets values from M3 (AB#5638), until then the preset
  is a buyer and outside its corridor.

  Every preset creates the community-operator customer (demo-customer-01),
  the shared "EC Demo Community" facility and the 2 EnergyCommunity/EnergyPrice
  (consumption 0.18 / feed-in 0.10 EUR). legacy keeps the historic 14 + 3
  members exactly (numbers …0801-0814 / …0901-0903, names, facilities,
  PartitionFactors; the 3 + 1 metering points on the shared facility exist
  only in legacy). The other presets generate their members with
  simulation-tools/presets.py (embedded as JSON literals; metering point
  number AT00999900000 + communityCode + 16-digit suffix, PartitionFactor
  100, fictional names). Per member: customer, facility
  (EnergyCommunity/AssociatedFacilities), metering point (ParentChild to the
  facility), ONE raw Basic.Energy/EnergyMeasurement anchor (consumer
  1-1:1.9.0 G.01, producer 1-1:2.9.0 G.01; no 1-1:1.9.0 P.01 any more - an
  existing one stays until the reset 'full' removes it) and an
  EnergyCommunity/ParticipationPeriod from participationFrom to 2099-12-31.
  Every metering point gets MeteringDataSource = Simulated and its size:
  consumers EnergyConsumption + LoadProfile, producers
  EnergyProductionCapacity + ProductionType - on create AND on every re-run,
  so the metering points of an existing legacy tenant (eg-urstein) get them
  by re-running with preset legacy.
  SETTINGS REVISION: when the tenant has no EnergyCommunity/SimulationSettings,
  or newRevision is true (then every existing revision is first marked
  SupersededByReset), one revision is created: Preset, EffectiveFrom, Seed,
  MemberSpread (legacy 0, others 0.25) and the simulation defaults spelled
  out (ConsumptionFactor 1, PvCapacityFactor 1, PvSpecificYield 1050,
  MemberScale 1, BackfillDays 730, DailyRun true, NearRealTime false,
  Noise Off, Weather ClearSky). The allocation cut-off and key are community
  settings (EnergyCommunity/CommunitySettings), not simulation settings. Revisions are never seeded, so InstallBlueprint -f keeps them.
  Idempotent - every entity is upserted via GetOrCreateRtEntitiesByType@1
  keyed on a stable natural key (facility Name, metering-point
  MeteringPointNumber, customer/anchor/period/price RtWellKnownName), so a
  second run creates nothing new. The city parent is the one association a
  re-run still emits: an existing facility WITHOUT a parent gets it (repair
  for tenants built by 2.2-2.8.0, e.g. eg-urstein: re-run the generator
  with the tenant's preset); a facility that has a parent keeps it. The Producer subtype is
  EnergyCommunity/Producer (exact type the value simulators classify as
  producer), NOT Basic.Energy/Producer.

community-simulator-range / daily-community-simulation (…b08 / …b09,
DataFlow simulate-community …b07, AB#5632)
  SimulateEnergyMeasurements@2: values only for the raw channels
  (1-1:1.9.0 G.01 consumer, 1-1:2.9.0 G.01 producer) of metering points with
  MeteringDataSource = Simulated, sized from their own attributes, PV
  calibrated to PvSpecificYield, randomness from (Seed, MeteringPointNumber),
  per day the applicable SimulationSettings revision (non-superseded,
  greatest effective date). Writes into the raw archive
  ec0000000000000000000a01 and returns a summary (anchors simulated/skipped,
  datapoints, kWh per OBIS, revisions used, warnings).
  - community-simulator-range (…b08): window from the input
    { "startDate": "...T00:00:00Z", "numDays": n }; backfill in chunks of
    <= 31 days.
  - daily-community-simulation (…b09): FromPolling every 24 h +
    ExecutePipelineCommand; creates missing raw anchors for the simulated
    metering points (field filter MeteringDataSource = 1, no P.01), then
    simulates the previous UTC calendar day.
  Not in 2.8.0: the /simulation/reset HTTP route (needs the role seed of the
  Base security work, AB#5627). The allocation registers G.03 / G.01T / P.01T
  come from EnergyCommunity.Base 2.10.0 (allocate-community-energy, AB#5635),
  which reads the raw channels written here.

reset-simulated-master-data (…b0b, DataFlow reset-simulation …b0a, AB#5633)
  Step of the reset 'full' of src/blueprints/reset-community.ps1 (RST-03),
  input { "dryRun": false }. Deletes every EnergyCommunity/Consumer and
  EnergyCommunity/Producer with MeteringDataSource = Simulated together with
  ALL its EnergyMeasurement anchors (any OBIS code, including the @1 leftover
  1-1:1.9.0 P.01) and participation periods, then every OperatingFacility
  whose metering points are all simulated (at least one) and the Customer
  owning it when that is the customer's only facility. EDA and self-reported
  metering points (and the facilities / customers still serving one),
  prices, settings revisions and reset requests stay. Archive rows are not
  touched: run it only through reset-community.ps1, which drops and
  re-creates the archives. dryRun true only logs what it would delete.

energy-simulator / energy-simulator-range / daily-simulation (…b02 / …b03 /
…b06, DataFlow simulate-energy-measurements …b01, AB#4571 / AB#4701) - @1,
unchanged in 2.8.0 (energydemo stays on it, D6)
  Generate deterministic synthetic 15-minute metering values for the
  Basic.Energy/EnergyMeasurement ANCHOR entities that already exist in the
  tenant (they do not create any entities): PV curve for anchors whose
  parent metering point is an EnergyCommunity/Producer (default 50 kWp
  peak), BDEW H0 load profile for all others (default 500 kWh/day), one
  datapoint per 15-minute slot, written into the Base 2.x raw archive
  energy-measurements (ec0000000000000000000a01).
  - energy-simulator (…b02): fixed backfill window (startDate 2025-01-01,
    numDays 365 — edit the pipeline definition to reshape the dataset)
  - energy-simulator-range (…b03): on-demand variant; startDate + numDays
    come from the ExecutePipelineCommand input
    (e.g. an input file: { "startDate": "2026-07-20T00:00:00Z", "numDays": 3 }, passed via ExecutePipeline -f)

Self-contained flow for a fresh demo/test tenant:
  ExecutePipeline create-demo-community     (master data, anchors, settings)
  ExecutePipeline community-simulator-range (fills the raw archive, <= 31 d each)
  ./backfill-rollups.ps1                    (populates the rollup ladder)
  deploy simulate-community                 (daily-community-simulation continues)

DISABLED BY DEFAULT: all seven pipelines are seeded with System/Enabled =
false and DeploymentState 0, so a fresh install can never create or write
data on its own (the two daily runs carry a FromPolling@1 trigger, which
only fires once an operator enables and deploys their DataFlow). To run: enable the pipeline, DeployDataFlow /
DeployPipeline (Mesh Adapter 670…002 must be online), ExecutePipeline, then
UndeployDataFlow and set Enabled = false again. Re-applying the blueprint
does NOT reset Enabled: it is tenant-owned since System.Communication 3.36.0
(AB#5309). See src/blueprints/README.md ("Simulation") for the full runbook.

Prerequisites:
- EnergyCommunity.Base 2.x installed and the energy-measurements archives
  activated (install-tenant.ps1 ActivateArchive phase)
- For create-demo-community: Locations.Austria (1.1.0 or later) installed,
  or another Basic/City directory holding a city for defaultZipcode
  (install-tenant.ps1 installs Locations.Austria unless -SkipLocations).
  Deliberately NOT a blueprintDependency - see the comment there.
- For the value simulators only: EnergyMeasurement anchor entities exist
  (well-known name <meteringPointRtId>_<obisCode>, System/ParentChild to
  the metering point) — created by create-demo-community, by EDA ingest
  (EnergyCommunity.EdaIntegration), or seeded as test master data

2.4.0 splits the seed across one file per topic (AB#4758 `seedDataPaths`) —
identical entities, no data change. It therefore requires an engine that knows
`seedDataPaths`: an older engine drops the unknown property, finds no
`seedDataPath` and installs an EMPTY seed while still reporting success.
Install 2.3.0 on such tenants.

2.4.0 -> 2.5.0: CK floors only - Basic 2.1.0, Basic.Energy 1.7 and EnergyCommunity 4.6, the
set EnergyCommunity.Base 2.6.0 installs. No entity changed.

2.5.0 -> 2.6.0 (AB#5359): CK floors only - Basic 2.2, Basic.Energy 1.8 and EnergyCommunity 4.7,
the set EnergyCommunity.Base 2.7.0 installs, rebuilt against System 2.4.0. No entity changed.

2.6.0 -> 2.7.0 (AB#5528): CK floors only - Basic 2.3, Basic.Energy 1.9 and EnergyCommunity 4.8,
the set EnergyCommunity.Base 2.8.0 installs, rebuilt against System 2.5.0. No entity changed.

2.7.0 -> 2.8.0 (AB#5632): presets, settings revisions and SimulateEnergyMeasurements@2.
- create-demo-community takes the input contract above (preset, seed, communityCode,
  effectiveFrom, participationFrom, newRevision), creates the SimulationSettings revision,
  sets size + MeteringDataSource on every metering point, creates raw anchors only (no
  1-1:1.9.0 P.01) and sets ParticipationPeriod.From from participationFrom (default
  2024-01-01; a re-run moves an existing legacy period from 2025-08-04 to it).
- New DataFlow simulate-community (…b07) with community-simulator-range (…b08) and
  daily-community-simulation (…b09) on @2. New seed file
  seed-data/data-flows/simulate-community.yaml.
- b02 / b03 / b06 are unchanged.
- New DataFlow reset-simulation (…b0a) with reset-simulated-master-data (…b0b, AB#5633) for
  the reset 'full' of src/blueprints/reset-community.ps1. New seed file
  seed-data/data-flows/reset-simulation.yaml.
- Requires EnergyCommunity.Base 2.10 (floor [2.10,3.0)): the allocation pipeline and
  EnergyCommunity 4.9 come with it.
- CK: EnergyCommunity 4.9 (SimulationSettings, SimulationResetRequest, MeteringDataSource,
  LoadProfile). Simulation declares the same ckModelDependencies as its seeds (Basic /
  Basic.Energy unchanged at the Base floors, EnergyCommunity 4.9 like Base 2.10.0). RISK: EnergyCommunity.Registration 2.6.0 is compiled against EnergyCommunity 4.8.0,
  and a compiled CK model pins its dependencies exactly. A tenant that imports Registration
  AND gets EnergyCommunity 4.9.0 from this blueprint can end with Registration unresolvable
  (ResolveFailed) until a Registration build against 4.9.0 is published. Simulation tenants
  are demo/test tenants without Registration today; check before installing 2.8.0 on one
  that has it.

2.8.0 -> 2.8.1 (AB#6014): create-demo-community parents every operating facility to a
  Basic/City. Up to 2.8.0 the generated facilities had no parent, and the Energy Community app
  fails on them with "City data not found" (the facility form reads the city from that
  association, as the app's own create flow writes it).
- City = the Basic/City whose Zipcode equals the facility address zip code, else the city of
  the new optional input defaultZipcode (default 5020, Salzburg: the simulation's location).
  A zip code shared by several cities takes the first match.
- No city for defaultZipcode: the run fails before anything is written (ExecuteCSharp@1
  throws; all updates go out in the one ApplyChanges@2 at the end), the message names the zip
  code and Locations.Austria. No half-built facility.
- Repair: a re-run links every existing facility that has no parent (eg-urstein: re-run with
  the tenant's preset, e.g. {}); facilities with a parent are untouched.
- No new blueprint or CK dependency (Basic/City is in Basic, already pinned), so a patch:
  Locations.Austria stays a documented prerequisite. Base floor unchanged ([2.10,3.0)).
2.8.1 -> 2.8.2 (AB#5528): System.Communication ranges only - the upper bound moves from 4.0
to 5.0 in blueprint.yaml and every seed ([3.22,5.0)), the floors stay. Nothing in this blueprint
touches what System.Communication 4.0.0 renames (Pool -> DeploymentSite, Manages -> Hosts), so
the same seeds install on 3.x and 4.x. Without the widening a tenant migrated to 4.x refuses
every re-apply / update of this blueprint. No entity changed.
